acceptedWorkstreams.title: Confirm which Zedu social accounts exist, then restore only those links
acceptedWorkstreams.description:
Checked 22 Oct 2026: 7 public pages link to four accounts, all under the old name or a bare ID (instagram.com/telex.im, tiktok.com/@telexim, x.com/teleximapp, facebook.com/profile.php?id=61578751079130). In zedu-fe on cybertron-integration there are no social links in the source at all, so the next deploy removes them without replacement.

Approach: 1) The team confirms which Zedu accounts exist, who controls them and what each is called; agents cannot create or rename accounts. 2) Rename the old handles where the platform allows it, which keeps followers, and create new ones only where it does not. 3) Add the confirmed links back in one place in the footer. 4) Re-check every public page with curl and confirm no link still uses an old handle.

Limit: I could not check whether the four accounts are active or who owns them.
